result.brief: 提出并行不一致性引导（PIG），用轻量辅助模型估计并行解码与顺序解码的偏差，按置信度逐步加入 token 以加速扩散语言模型推理。
result.reason: Diffusion language model decoding acceleration via auxiliary inconsistency estimator; connects to continuous/latent language modeling interests though it is discrete masked diffusion, not continuous language.
